description: Retrieve a FRMR document with metadata, raw JSON, and summary. First use list_frmr_documents to find available virtual paths (for example `FRMR.documentation.json#KSI` or `FRMR.documentation.json#FRR.MAS`). Returns full document content for KSI, MAS, VDR, SCN, FRD, and other FRMR types. [Category: Discovery]

path.description: Virtual path to the FRMR document (e.g. FRMR.documentation.json#KSI)

name: get_frmr_document
title: Get FRMR Document
